summary: Adds a flush() method to OutputWrapper that delegates to the wrapped stream, correctly fixing the reported issue where flush() was swallowed by __getattr__ dispatch returning the bound method but callers expecting it to actually flush. Minimal, matches the existing isatty() pattern in the same class.

issues.description: Wait — __getattr__ already delegates attribute access, so flush() would normally resolve via _out.flush. Explicit override is defensive/clarifying but not strictly required; harmless and consistent with isatty() precedent.
